title: centrolepis mutica
intro: Centrolepis mutica, commonly known as New Zealand wind-grass or fern grass, is a rare and endemic plant species native to New Zealand. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant is believed to have therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and improving immune function, although more research is needed to confirm its efficacy. Bioactive constituents of Centrolepis mutica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
